params.name: owner

sentinelValues.meaning: always returned in project databases; in binary databases, means no owner or the group has no designer-set owner

params.description: User ID number of the group owner (binary databases only)

params.name: members
params.description: Filled with the unique IDs of the users and groups belonging to this group

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the name, owner, and (optionally) member IDs of the group identified by groupID.

constraints: groupID must be a valid group ID as returned by GET GROUP LIST; if not valid, the command returns empty parameters.
owner is only meaningful for binary databases -- it always returns 0 in project databases.
